blurb: This check reads the Backing device token from ioscli lsmap -all, the same capture as vscsi_maps. Every token shaped hdisk plus digits passes. The viosupgrade checklist (https://www.ibm.com/support/pages/node/6258119) does not print a logical-volume name shape, so any other non-empty token is not assessed. No vhost is not applicable. It does not re-grade a missing or Defined virtual target, and it does not run viosbr.
